 THE TIMES OF INDIA | Nov 10, 2026, 10:54:42 IST SUMMARY India vs United Arab Emirates, Under-19 Asia Cup Live Score: India U19 face the UAE in a crucial ACC U19 Asia Cup group-stage encounter, with both sides looking to recover from defeats in their previous fixtures against Pakistan. 
 India suffered a narrow three-wicket loss despite a superb century from Arjun Rajput, who scored 107 to give his side a competitive platform. However, India's batting line-up failed to build on his effort and was bowled out for 208. Pakistan's Hamza Zahoor then struck a match-winning century to guide his side home, leaving India with plenty to address ahead of their next assignment. 
 The UAE also endured disappointment against Pakistan in a high-scoring contest, where they showed resistance but ultimately failed to secure a victory. They now face a formidable challenge against an Indian side eager to regain momentum and strengthen its position in the tournament. 
 India enjoy a commanding 7-3 advantage in their 10 Youth ODI meetings against the UAE. Their most recent ACC U19 Asia Cup clash was particularly one-sided, with India registering a massive 234-run victory. While history favours India, the UAE will look to capitalise on any lingering pressure and script an upset. The toss and team combinations could prove important in shaping the contest. Commentary

 09:58 (IST) Nov 10 India vs UAE, Under-19 Asia Cup Live: Both sides seek a crucial turnaround With the group standings beginning to take shape, this fixture carries added significance for both teams. 
 India will be determined to restore their campaign's momentum and reinforce their credentials as tournament favourites. The UAE, meanwhile, will look to exploit any signs of nervousness following India's defeat to Pakistan. 
 A strong start, particularly with the ball, could be crucial for the UAE, while India's response with both bat and ball will be closely watched. The toss and confirmed playing XIs will provide the first indication of how the two sides plan to approach this important encounter.
 09:57 (IST) Nov 10 India vs UAE, Under-19 Asia Cup Live: India enjoy a clear head-to-head advantage India have dominated the historical Youth ODI rivalry between the two sides, winning seven of their 10 encounters, while the UAE have registered three victories. 
 Their most recent meeting in the ACC U19 Asia Cup also produced a one-sided result, with India securing a massive 234-run win. 
 That record gives India a psychological advantage heading into the contest, although past results will count for little if the UAE manage to put the Indian youngsters under pressure early.
 09:57 (IST) Nov 10 India vs UAE, Under-19 Asia Cup Live: UAE eye an opportunity to cause an upset The UAE will also be looking to recover from their previous group-stage setback against Pakistan. They showed glimpses of their potential in a high-scoring contest but ultimately could not do enough to cross the finish line. 
 Facing one of the tournament's strongest sides presents a significant challenge, but the UAE will view this fixture as an opportunity to make a statement. They will need a disciplined bowling effort and a more consistent batting performance to trouble India.
 09:56 (IST) Nov 10 India vs UAE, Under-19 Asia Cup Live: Arjun Rajput's century goes in vain India had a major reason to be disappointed after their previous outing, as Arjun Rajput's impressive 107 could not prevent a defeat against Pakistan. 
 India were bowled out for 208, leaving their bowlers with a challenging task. 
 Pakistan's Hamza Zahoor then produced a sensational match-winning century to guide his side to a three-wicket victory. Rajput's effort was a major positive for India, but the batting unit will need greater support from the rest of the line-up.

 India will be eager to put their narrow defeat against arch-rivals Pakistan behind them when they take on the UAE in their ACC U19 Asia Cup fixture. The young Indian side suffered a three-wicket loss in a high-pressure encounter despite a brilliant century from Arjun Rajput. With the tournament campaign still alive, India will be keen to regroup, address their shortcomings and return to winning ways.
 India vs United Arab Emirates, Under-19 Asia Cup Live Score: India U19 will look to bounce back from their heartbreaking three-wicket defeat against Pakistan when they face the UAE in their ACC U19 Asia Cup fixture.

With both sides seeking a turnaround, India will start as favourites, while the UAE will aim to produce an upset.
